title: Unbounded proper projection formula with finite coefficients
statement: Let X and Y be schemes, g : X \to Y a proper morphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and \Lambda a finite commutative ring. On the ordinary unbounded derived categories of small-etale \Lambda-module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], the canonical projection map [def-kun-projection-formula-map] Rg_* M \otimes^L N \to Rg_*(M \otimes^L Lg^* N) is an isomorphism, natural in M and N. There is no Noetherian, quasi-compactness, boundedness, constructibility, or Tor-amplitude hypothesis.

source.place: isIso_rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap_of_finite, finite proper case; Stacks Project Tag 0F0G, Lemma 59.96.6

proof.text: A finite ring is torsion: the sequence of multiples of its unit repeats, so some positive integer annihilates the unit and hence every ring element. This includes the zero ring.

Apply the general torsion-ring unbounded proper projection formula of lem-kun-0f0g to the finite commutative ring and proper g. Exact inverse image of constant-coefficient etale module sheaves identifies Lg-star with inverse image. The canonical maps agree by their adjoint-of-counit definition. This gives the source theorem for all M and N; naturality of the projection transformation makes it an isomorphism of bifunctors. This is the finite-coefficient source statement already imported by the item, not a new Lean obligation.
